elements.texte:
[cheerful] A function takes a value, transforms it, then returns the result.

Floor rounds down: 29.90 becomes 29.

In the query, floor of price calculates the points for each product.

Careful: round, on the other hand, rounds to the nearest: 29.90 gives 30.

With round, almost every product would earn one point too many.

elements.texte:
[cheerful] During double points week, held once a year, only whole euros count.

Floor of price removes the cents, then times 2 calculates the points earned.

We multiply the function’s result: floor of price times 2 gives 58.

Plus, minus, times and divided by calculate just like a calculator, except between two integers: 7 divided by 2 gives 3.

And percent gives the remainder of a division: 80 percent 6 gives 2.

With boxes of 6, 80 units make 13 full boxes, with 2 left over.

[cheerful] To round a number to a whole number, there are three functions.
